answer: PoA resists Sybil control by bonding collateral to each identity and linking equivocation evidence across time, operators, and signing keys: when k coordinated identities issue conflicting attestations, the aggregate penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the correlated set, making a swarm labeled reef, sparrow, or falcon economically irrational even when individual bonds are small.
